title: RTSettings
description: RTSettings is a simple plugin that allows players to turn certain settings on and off.
body:
RTSettings
**RTSettings** is a simple plugin that allows players to enable or disable certain settings. **🔌 Dependencies** - **[ProtocolLib](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/1997/)** is required. **✨ Features** Players can individually enable or disable the following options: - ✅ Public chat messages - ✅ Private messages - ✅ Hotbar messages - ✅ Server messages - ✅ Advancement notifications - ✅ Command sounds **🧩 PlaceholderAPI Support** RTSettings includes built-in PlaceholderAPI support. **⚠️ No download, registration, or hook command is required.** If PlaceholderAPI is installed on your server, all placeholders work automatically. **Available Placeholders** ``` %rtsettings_publicchat% %rtsettings_privatechat% %rtsettings_hotbarmessages% %rtsettings_servermessages% %rtsettings_advancements% %rtsettings_commandsound% ```
